minutes.headline: Town Manager wants the historic commission/APD merger kept off the May town meeting warrant; it is deferred.
minutes.summary: The commission approved its prior minutes with one formatting change. The chair then reported that the Town Manager does not want the Historical Commission/APDC merger on the May warrant and prefers a broader effort with the town's consultant, possibly for a November special town meeting. Other items were updates on the municipal building design committee and Brooks House, Town Hall chimney and weathervane repairs, 763 Mass Ave, the historic survey and 50 Main St, plus the expiring remote-participation law.

votes.motion: Approve the prior meeting minutes as presented, subject to one formatting change (rename New Business to Current Business).

budget_items.topic: Municipal building project cost to taxpayers
budget_items.what_was_said: The design committee still has to decide what the town meeting presentation looks like and how much the project will cost taxpayers. No decisions were reached.

Structural repair at the top of Town Hall is not in the current contract because it was too expensive, so the contract was scaled back to available funding. The weathervane cannot be installed until the repair is done.
The historic commission paid for a new weathervane.

decisions.decision: The merger warrant article will not go on the May annual town meeting warrant; the Town Manager will email the consultant, and the work is aimed at a special town meeting in November.
The chair will try to have the town's consultant Adam join the next commission meeting by Zoom, possibly at a different time than 7:30.
The next meeting is set for April 10; minutes go to Ellen after the formatting change.
